claim: Test whether affinity materially reduces uncached input or request latency in repeated synthetic native Responses tool loops resembling current context sizes; not a universal performance claim.
fixed: function schema and deterministic tool results
independence: Different early instructions nonce per arm and session; Session_id=Thread-Id=prompt_cache_key remains stable within each session. Tool histories include actual function call IDs and outputs.
primary_metric: sum(input_tokens-cached_tokens) over non-first requests in both sessions per run; pair is experimental unit. Also report all-turn totals.

latency_acceptance.limiter: remote inference/cache/network; also report local process cpu/wall and container stats

decision: Retain affinity only on material reproducible benefit without reliability/distribution concerns. Failure to meet criterion is no demonstrated benefit, not equivalence; prefer original round-robin if no benefit established and no separately proven continuity need. Transfer to Will is an operational conservative-default choice, not evidence of measured Will performance.
validity_gates: All terminal responses completed with valid usage 0<=cached<=input
Correct forced step functions and exact final output, linked continuation IDs
Context-size divergence <1 percent per paired run
At least2 distinct selected accounts per off session; exactly1 per on session
All request logs correlate to generated test identity and have single successful selected auth; no quota/cooldown/error/retry
Stop at any invalid run; retain it and do not silently replace or drop it
limits: Synthetic controlled workload, not native T3 app-server acceptance
Natural current sample overlaps evaluation, is not independent baseline
Luna results not proof for Astra/Sol or other providers
Mac host busy with unrelated processes, latency conservatively qualified
No public API pricing or subscription-quota savings inference
calibrations: calibration-02.json 98k input success; no calibration requests included in sweep
request_order: Reverse session order on alternating tool turns to break cycle aliasing for two or three eligible accounts
supersedes: Original pair-1-off retained INVALID: pre-existing third-account cooldown reduced pool to2, fixed2-session order aliased RR. No response failure, but arm did not rotate. No data from that run used here.
